title: WHAT IF YOU COULD SEE HOW LONG EVERYONE HAS LEFT?

segments.line: A man at the bus stop has 12 seconds left.
Sam grabs his collar and pulls.
A truck runs the red light.
His timer spins. 12 seconds becomes 41 years.
What if you could see how long everyone has left?
Green means decades. Orange means years.
see your own, not in a mirror. Then one

shots.line: A man at the bus stop has 12 seconds left.
shots.note: Wide rainy street at night; a man waits at the bus stop, red timer 00:00:00:12 nearly touching his head; Sam watches from the curb; rain, wet road reflections, red traffic light

shots.line: Sam grabs his collar and pulls.
shots.note: Close-up: Sam grabs the man's collar and pulls; man's face swaps neutral to shock; timer 00:00:00:03 ticking; blurred street behind

shots.line: A truck runs the red light.
shots.note: Wide from the other side: a truck blasts through the red light through the exact spot where the man stood; Sam and the man safe at the curb; brake lights, rain

shots.line: His timer spins. 12 seconds becomes 41 years.
shots.note: The man's timer HUGE on the dark void: 00:00:00:12 spins and flickers through digits, then settles on 41 YEARS in green; breakdown pills above it

shots.line: What if you could see how long everyone has left?
shots.note: Title card on the dark void: glowing ?? ??:??:??:?? pill, then WHAT IF YOU COULD SEE / HOW LONG EVERYONE HAS LEFT? in yellow caps

shots.line: Green means decades. Orange means years.
shots.note: Rules on the void: yellow banner GREEN MEANS DECADES; three outline figures with green 52 YEARS, orange 3 YEARS, red 00:00:00:12 pills; labels DECADES / YEARS / DAYS
Close-up: the red figure (Lily) with a pulsing red timer 00:00:00:12; yellow banner RED MEANS HURRY

shots.line: see your own, not in a mirror. Then one
shots.note: Close-up: Sam at the bathroom mirror; his reflection has NO timer above its head; red label NOT IN A MIRROR; blurred bathroom behind
Kitchen in the morning: Lily (yellow, small) at the table with a cereal box; Sam across from her; her green pill 81 YRS 6 MO nearly touching her head
Extreme close-up: Lily's timer HUGE red 02:06:19:45 ticking down in real time; breakdown pills 2 DAYS / 6 HOURS / 19 MINUTES above; green 81 YRS 4 MO at the top; background heavily blurred
Macro insert: wall calendar THIS WEEK, red X marks, LILY'S B-DAY! 2:40 PM circled in red on SATURDAY; red label SATURDAY; PART 1 banner pops in at the end
Wide rooftop at dusk; Sam looks over the city, timers flicker in the distance; title card PART 1
